messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: Error in the final step of titan
parts:
Hi Minita,

This is actually the very first step of the EM algorithm of Titan. In fact, because it failed at EM iteration 1, I suspect this may have something to do with your input counts or wig/logRatio file. 
1) Make sure that there is a header line in your tumour counts file (v1.5.1 allows users to specify "header" as TRUE/FALSE in loadAlleleCounts)
2) The positions, reference read count, and non-ref read count columns should be integers/numeric.  If they are not, then the sorting on positions will be done lexicographically, which would not work at all in the HMM. (v1.5.1 makes some checks on this and returns an error if these columns are not integer/numeric types)
3) The 7th column in the tumour read counts file generated by TitanRunner is actually entirely unnecessary.  It was a legacy feature for previous versions. In another thread in this group, Rosemary pointed out that for positions with 0 depth, the 7th column will be missing a value. This can be problematic when loading the file in R.

Hopefully these will address the issue.

Best,
Gavin
